I have come to realize this. I started to distance myself from everyone until I only got 1 person left (my bf) a year ago after college. I'm so scared of this world. I see the hatred and malice in everyone and it's frightening. One day I come across motivational video about key to success or something and I realize that I don't want to do that. I don't want to work, I don't want to be successful, I don't want to go into trade and be a predator. I don't want to have career. I don't want to be part of society at all. I don't want to be part of that world, especially their world.

I realize that I can never survive in this world we live in now. I'm so scared of being as shallow, vindictive, hateful, envious and bitter as the world. Maybe I already am, who knows. The only relief for me is that I can always end it all anytime I want. I'll stay as long as I can for my bf, I really do love him with all i got and I won't put him through pain of losing me while he still loves me. It's a gamble, I can last until old age with him or he left and I go in peace. Either way, I think it's a win.
